C9000137.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 137 (One-tape time simulation in two-fifths-power space.; papers: Simulating One-Tape Time in Two-Fifths-Power Space; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/137.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C137_WEIGHTED.statement: The actual recursive Add schedule translates exactly its target by the fixed semantic augmented word, restores all other registers from arbitrary entry contents, and has the weighted suspended-storage bound, including the epoch specialization. Its bit interpretation retains the original uniform-implementation hypotheses A137_UNIFORM_BITS.

C137_ALGEBRA.statement: The homogeneous Boolean lookup extensions, including augmentation, satisfy the finite-field top-coefficient extraction identities at arbitrary shifted arguments.

C137_SCHEDULE.statement: The recursively implemented ordinary and history schedules satisfy additive translation and non-target restoration, without an oracle for nonbase outputs or clean-register assumptions.

C137_STORAGE.statement: The actual schedule retains the guess only on history-to-array calls; one global vector pool and one reusable scratch area suffice, with suspended storage bounded by weighted dependency paths.

C137_EPOCH.statement: The epoch dependency graph admits at most one expensive history-to-array edge per epoch and weighted path length O(E(k+kc+1)).

C137_VISITS.statement: The total raw visit kernels agree with the capped one-tape evolution and some offset has at most ceil(1+T/b) visits.

C137_REPLAY.statement: All block replay flags hold exactly for the unique raw reference controller transcript, with total local replay kernels.

C137_FACTORED.statement: The concrete epoch round history has the semantic factored identity, guess length kc <= d, uniform total local kernels, and polynomially described navigation.

C137_REALIZATION.statement: Total capped raw visits and their finite packed representation realize one-tape evolution with radius-T access; arbitrary-raw replay has a unique complete transcript; semantic epoch words satisfy the factored identity and the reviewed evaluator contract; actual averaging and padding recover the capped controller. This is a semantic/resource-model theorem, not a compiled bit-machine theorem.

C137_BIT_REALIZATION.statement: Uniform bit implementations of finite encodings, radius-T access, binary suffix enumeration, Boolean lookup generation, field arithmetic, and actual graph navigation attain the stated local-space and bookkeeping costs. This remains open; it is not inferred from the semantic theorem.

C137_MAIN.statement: The full supplied-cap one-tape machine theorem computes the finite-control and halting outcome in soft-O(T^(2/5)) work bits under the manuscript's access condition.

C137_SCALE_BARRIER.statement: Optimizing only the displayed three-scale estimate does not improve its two-fifths exponent and does not resolve the evaluator's correctness or storage invariant.
